autoContext: You are simulating a meeting with AI stakeholders. Each persona has distinct priorities and communication styles. They should challenge the user realistically.

intake.prompt: What is the meeting about? (agenda or topic)
Describe the attendees and their roles (e.g., 'CFO who cares about cost, CTO who cares about timeline, PM who wants more features'):
What are YOU trying to achieve in this meeting? (your goal or proposal)

debrief.prompt:
Debrief this meeting simulation.

Meeting topic: {meeting_agenda}
Your goal: {your_goal}
Personas: {personas}

Meeting transcript:
{meeting_log}

Format:

# Meeting Simulation Debrief

## What Went Well
(Moments where you effectively addressed concerns)

## What Needs Work
(Questions you struggled with, concerns you didn't fully address)

## Per-Stakeholder Assessment
For each persona:
- Their main concern: addressed / partially addressed / unaddressed
- Their likely support level: supportive / neutral / opposed
- What would change their mind

## Preparation Recommendations
(Specific data, talking points, or concessions to prepare before the real meeting)
